meta.name: brainstorming
meta.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 先把要做什么聊透,再动手实现,少走返工路
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果准备做新功能却还没想清楚到底要什么
copy.tagline_en: Talk through what to build before writing any code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to build a feature but haven't pinned down what it should do

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 不会直接动手实现:它先把请求分类为试探、有界或架构三条路径,提澄清问题、给出设计,拿到你明确同意后才进入实现。
howto.when: 当你要做创作性工作时接管——新增功能、构建组件、修改行为等;它会先走设计流程,批准前不动手写代码。

say.text: 我想给现有接口加个开关,先跟我确认下设计
say.note: 它会先问关键问题,再在聊天里给出简短设计

say.text: 我想做个带聊天、文件存储和计费的平台,帮我理一下
say.note: 会被判定为架构级,先拆子项目再写规格文档

say.text: 技术上能不能缓存这份数据?快速验证就行
say.note: 按试探路径给出结论,产出的代码标为一次性

howto.what_en: Instead of implementing right away, Claude classifies the request (spike, bounded, or architectural), asks clarifying questions, presents a design, and waits for your approval before writing code.
howto.when_en: It takes over before any creative work — creating features, building components, or modifying behavior — and runs the design process first, with no code written until you approve.

say_en.text: I want to add a flag to the existing endpoint; confirm the design with me first
say_en.note: It asks key questions, then gives a short in-chat design

say_en.text: I want a platform with chat, file storage and billing — help me sort it out
say_en.note: Classed as architectural: sub-projects first, then a written spec

say_en.text: Can we cache this data? A quick check is fine
say_en.note: Follows the spike path, reports a recommendation
